layout.description: Manage your profile and account settings

head.title: Learn Spanish, honestly
head.description: A Spanish and Portuguese learning app built on CEFR levels, comprehensible input and spaced repetition — with honest timelines instead of streak-chasing.

hero.eyebrow: Spanish now · Portuguese when you’re ready
hero.title: Learn Spanish the way the research says you actually will.
hero.body: Hablas is built on the CEFR framework, comprehensible input and spaced repetition — what language-teaching institutions actually use. No points, no leaderboards, no streak guilt. Just an honest read on how good you’re getting.
hero.passwordless: No password to remember — sign in with an emailed code or a passkey.

cefr.title: CEFR, tracked per skill
cefr.body: Reading, listening, speaking and writing are scored separately against the Council of Europe’s six levels — so a lagging skill shows up instead of hiding behind an average.

input.title: Input first, then real tasks
input.body: Lessons are built around things you actually do — book a room, describe your weekend — with grammar introduced as the tool the task needs, not as a chapter to endure.

spaced.title: Spaced repetition that adapts
spaced.body: Vocabulary and grammar enter an FSRS queue that models your own forgetting curve. Miss something repeatedly and it escalates into a short remedial drill instead of cycling forever.

trap.title: Built for the Spanish–Portuguese trap
trap.body: Add Portuguese once Spanish is solid, and every lesson names where it diverges. Separate decks that never interleave, because Portuñol is the predictable failure of learning both at once.

pacing.title: How long this actually takes
pacing.intro: These are the U.S. Foreign Service Institute’s own estimates for Spanish, at a sustainable six hours a week. Not marketing numbers — you should know what you’re signing up for.

cta.title: Find out where you actually stand.
cta.body: A placement test scores each skill separately and sets your starting level. Everything after that is paced off what you remember, not what you clicked.

footer.builtOn: Built on the {cefr} and {fsi} pacing data.
